changelog: Integrated minimap radar controller: continuous display on foot and in vehicles with configurable modes (Always, Vehicle, Disabled).
Clean minimap visuals: automatically hides native GTA V health and armor bars to prevent overlap with the HUD.
Modular HUD block dissociation: decouple and freely reposition identity, vitals, needs, modules and voice blocks.
Added physiological Stress and Bladder status modules with calm, warm, and critical states.
Complete /conf_acn_hud redesign: enlarged panel, instant text search filter, and distinct visual cards.
